name: breadcrumb
useFor: Use above a page head when a page sits inside a hierarchy of places or records (Texas, Ellis County, Site 14). Fold middle levels into BreadcrumbEllipsis when the trail is long; use asChild to render your router's link. A small outlined Diamond can replace the slash in a trail of map places.
constraints: A breadcrumb on a top-level page
Links that move or underline on hover
source: Not in Figma: built from the text tints and Slate, for a designer's review

examples.content:
import { Diamond } from "@/components/ui/diamond";
import { Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbEllipsis, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator } from "@/components/ui/breadcrumb";

export function Preview() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Texas</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Ellis County</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage>Site 14</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}

export function Collapsed() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Sites</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbEllipsis />
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Ellis County</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage>Site 14</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}

export function CustomSeparator() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Saved searches</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator>
          <Diamond size={8} variant="outline" />
        </BreadcrumbSeparator>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage>200+ ac near 138 kV</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}

title: Breadcrumb
description: A trail of 13px muted links ending in the current place in Forest, with a Slate slash between, like a path.
